verdict.rationale: Riskified's documented automation is event-driven: synchronous or asynchronous order decisions, decision notifications to a merchant endpoint, automated chargeback handling via gateway integrations, and Shopify auto-void and capture. Nothing in the evidence shows a way to define or schedule recurring jobs or workflows. Per-event triggers are not the same as a recurring schedule, so the axis applies but there is no evidence it is delivered.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
